items.title: Scream in the Night
items.description: 1935 Astor Pictures Corp. directed by Fred Newmeyer starring Lon Chaney Jr., Philip Ahn, Manuel Lopez and Sheila Terry.  Chaney plays dual roles as detective Jack Wilson and low-life Butch Curtain.  He's looking for infamous jewel thief Johnny Fly (Lopez).
